name: prompt-variable-auditor
description: Audit a prompt template against its variable schema and a value set -- undeclared placeholders, unused declarations, required variables with no value, and values that would break out of the context they are interpolated into. Renders nothing.

scripts.lint: node --check bin/prompt-variable-auditor.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/schema.mjs && node --check src/template.mjs && node --check src/text.mjs && node --check test/acceptance.test.mjs && node --check test/cli.test.mjs && node --check test/determinism.test.mjs && node --check test/helpers.mjs && node --check test/incomplete.test.mjs && node --check test/no-rendering.test.mjs && node --check test/ordering.test.mjs && node --check test/parse-failure.test.mjs && node --check test/rule-catalog.test.mjs && node --check test/sanitisation.test.mjs && node --check test/severity-outcomes.test.mjs && node --check test/template.test.mjs
scripts.example:failing: node bin/prompt-variable-auditor.mjs --template examples/unsafe/template.md --schema examples/unsafe/variables.json --values examples/unsafe/values.json; test $? -eq 1
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run example && npm run example:failing && npm run pack:check
